meta.solver: surrogate F2+F4+F5 (vectorised); full L2: run_batch (rk4_batch) h = 2 s
meta.estimator: S1: Saltelli et al. (2010); ST: Jansen (1999) (SALib's pairing) on SALib's second-order Saltelli design; S1_jansen: Jansen first order (cross-check); S2: SALib (Saltelli 2002); *_conf = half-width of the 95 % percentile-bootstrap CI (1000 resamples of the N base rows)
meta.design: SALib.sample.sobol.sample(scramble=True, seed=2026) on the unit cube, mapped by phonebatt.params.map_unit through the FINAL_SPEC §4 distributions
meta.output_unit: TTE in h; s_off blocks in percentage points
